mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (userid, commodityid, content, rating) VALUES (#{userid}, #{commodityid}, #{content}, #{rating})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.name AS userName, c.cname AS commodityName, i.ipath FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.userid = u.id LEFT JOIN commodity c ON r.commodityid = c.id LEFT JOIN image i ON c.id = i.commodityid WHERE r.commodityid = #{commodityid} ORDER BY r.createtime DESC

SELECT * FROM review WHERE userid = #{userid} AND commodityid = #{commodityid}
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(rating), 0) FROM review WHERE commodityid = #{commodityid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE commodityid = #{commodityid}
